Scope: `appearance.ts`, `scholar.css`, `render/common.ts`, `render/callouts.ts`, `render/section.ts`, `render/assessment.ts`, `render/navigation.ts`, `obsidian.ts`, `note-records.ts` (+ the emitters they call in `exam.ts`, `equation-presentation.ts`, `lesson-figures.ts`, `note-storage.ts`).

---

## 1. How appearance is installed and applied

### 1.1 Install path (appearance.ts)

- Snippet name is fixed: `appearance.ts:8` `const SNIPPET = "scholar";`
- Receipt name is fixed: `appearance.ts:9` `const RECEIPT = "scholar-appearance.json";`
- Entry point: `appearance.ts:73` `export async function installScholarAppearance(config: ScholarConfig): Promise<void> {`
  - `appearance.ts:74` `if (!config.obsidianRoot.trim()) return;` — blank vault config means "do nothing", no folders created (asserted by `tests/verify-scholar-appearance.mjs:88-92`).
  - `appearance.ts:77` `const settingsRoot = await safePathWithinRoot(obsidianRoot, resolve(obsidianRoot, ".obsidian"));`
  - Serialization: `appearance.ts:81` `await withFileMutationQueue(settingsRoot, async () => {`
- Three concrete paths written (all under `<vault>/.obsidian/`):
  - `appearance.ts:82` `.obsidian/appearance.json`
  - `appearance.ts:83` `.obsidian/snippets/${SNIPPET}.css` → `.obsidian/snippets/scholar.css`
  - `appearance.ts:84` `.obsidian/scholar-appearance.json`
  - Mirrored by the test helpers `tests/verify-scholar-appearance.mjs:27-29`.

- Appearance.json keys written: exactly one key, `enabledCssSnippets`:
  - `appearance.ts:116` `latest.enabledCssSnippets = [...(Array.isArray(enabled) ? enabled : []), SNIPPET];`
  - `appearance.ts:117` `await writeTextFileAtomic(obsidianRoot, appearancePath, `${JSON.stringify(latest, null, 2)}\n`);`
  - Validation of that key: `appearance.ts:40-42` (`enabledCssSnippets must be an array of names`).
  - **Only on first install**: `appearance.ts:98` `const firstInstall = receipt === undefined && previousCss === undefined;` guarded at `appearance.ts:110` `if (firstInstall) {`; the comment at `appearance.ts:111-112` states the policy: "Enable once. Thereafter Obsidian owns the preference, including an explicitly disabled snippet and receipt-free legacy installations."
- Receipt (ownership/versioning) keys: `appearance.ts:11-14` `interface AppearanceReceipt { schemaVersion: 1; installedCssSha256: string; }`; written at `appearance.ts:120-123`.

### 1.2 Where `cssclasses` is decided (single site)

`render/common.ts:148-154` is the **only** place any `cssclasses` value is produced:

```ts

149   const noteType = lines.find((line) => /^type: scholar-(home|book|chapter|section|exam|exam-paper|answer-key|tutor)$/.test(line))?.slice(6);

153   ].join("\n");

## 4. Known-degraded / compromise points (quoted)

   > `// An unquoted blank line terminates the Markdown blockquote. Keep both`
   > `// boundaries so adjacent records cannot become one collapsed callout.`
   Implemented as a leading and trailing `""` in every `collapsedRecord()`.
2. **Tables assembled by hand everywhere.** No row builder exists: `navigation.ts:23,40,43,45` (four different column counts: 3/4/2/2), `section.ts:196`, `assessment.ts:176`.    - `render/assessment.ts:47-53` (`tutorSourceFigures`):
     ```ts

Callers use different ones: `note-storage.ts:102` passes `tutorSourceFigures(...)` into `referencedFigureLines` while `renderTutorSession` itself computes the same set inline for `supplementalSourceFigureLines` — two code paths, one invariant.
   - `render/assessment.ts:108-109` (`examAnswerNoteText`) uses a **third** rule: `exam.scope.sectionIds.includes(section.id) ? section.snapshots || [] : []` — no `chapterIds` fallback, so a chapter-scoped exam contributes zero figures to its own paper.

7. **Hidden, not omitted, frontmatter.** `scholar.css:158` `/* Hide internal identifiers, not useful status/progress or the stored metadata. */` then `:159-165` hide ten property keys in the Obsidian Properties UI. 10. **Obsidian-specific constraints, quoted where stated:**
    - `appearance.ts:99-100` `// Obsidian can edit its preferences while setup reads the shipped snippet. / Merge into its newest validated settings, rather than the earlier snapshot.`
    - `appearance.ts:111-112` `// Enable once. Thereafter Obsidian owns the preference, including an / explicitly disabled snippet and receipt-free legacy installations.`
    - `appearance.ts:85` `// A settings subdirectory or file can independently be a junction/symlink.`
    - `obsidian.ts:276-278` `// A CRLF note's tail begins "\r\n", so a plain startsWith("\n") test misses it / and injects a stray LF, giving the note mixed endings and breaking the / byte-identical round trip on every projection.`
    - `obsidian.ts:456-457` `// Windows treats case-only title changes as the same path. Hop through / a private sibling so Obsidian receives the exact current title case.`
    - `obsidian.ts:654-655` `// Answer papers are learner-owned. Only explicit presentation creates / them; projection must not read or repair a draft the learner is editing.`
    - `obsidian.ts:579-580` `// Reserve answer-key paths even before grading so grading cannot start / overwriting an exam that already occupies the eventual key's name.`
11. **The answer paper duplicates its own title.** It opens with `# ${markdownText(exam.title)}` (`render/assessment.ts:117`) while `scholar.css:131` does `.scholar-exam-paper .inline-title { display: none; }` and `:132` hides `.metadata-container` — the note is the only artifact that needs its Obsidian chrome suppressed to avoid two titles. [INFERENCE: the pair reads as a deliberate compensation, but no comment states it.]
12. **`exam.ts:278-285`** writes the answer region as literal HTML-comment fences inside a callout, and `OPEN_ANSWER_LINES = 8` (`exam.ts:266`) is a fixed blank-line count — visually an 8-line gap with no placeholder text.

Scope: `appearance.ts`, `scholar.css`, `render/common.ts`, `render/callouts.ts`, `render/section.ts`, `render/assessment.ts`, `render/navigation.ts`, `obsidian.ts`, `note-records.ts` (+ the emitters they call in `exam.ts`, `equation-presentation.ts`, `lesson-figures.ts`, `note-storage.ts`).

---

## 1. How appearance is installed and applied

### 1.1 Install path (appearance.ts)

- Snippet name is fixed: `appearance.ts:8` `const SNIPPET = "scholar";`
- Receipt name is fixed: `appearance.ts:9` `const RECEIPT = "scholar-appearance.json";`
- Entry point: `appearance.ts:73` `export async function installScholarAppearance(config: ScholarConfig): Promise<void> {`
  - `appearance.ts:74` `if (!config.obsidianRoot.trim()) return;` — blank vault config means "do nothing", no folders created (asserted by `tests/verify-scholar-appearance.mjs:88-92`).
  - `appearance.ts:77` `const settingsRoot = await safePathWithinRoot(obsidianRoot, resolve(obsidianRoot, ".obsidian"));`
  - Serialization: `appearance.ts:81` `await withFileMutationQueue(settingsRoot, async () => {`
- Three concrete paths written (all under `<vault>/.obsidian/`):
  - `appearance.ts:82` `.obsidian/appearance.json`
  - `appearance.ts:83` `.obsidian/snippets/${SNIPPET}.css` → `.obsidian/snippets/scholar.css`
  - `appearance.ts:84` `.obsidian/scholar-appearance.json`

- Appearance.json keys written: exactly one key, `enabledCssSnippets`:
  - `appearance.ts:116` `latest.enabledCssSnippets = [...(Array.isArray(enabled) ? enabled : []), SNIPPET];`
  - `appearance.ts:117` `await writeTextFileAtomic(obsidianRoot, appearancePath, `${JSON.stringify(latest, null, 2)}\n`);`
  - Validation of that key: `appearance.ts:40-42` (`enabledCssSnippets must be an array of names`).
  - **Only on first install**: `appearance.ts:98` `const firstInstall = receipt === undefined && previousCss === undefined;` guarded at `appearance.ts:110` `if (firstInstall) {`; the comment at `appearance.ts:111-112` states the policy: "Enable once. Thereafter Obsidian owns the preference, including an explicitly disabled snippet and receipt-free legacy installations."
- Receipt (ownership/versioning) keys: `appearance.ts:11-14` `interface AppearanceReceipt { schemaVersion: 1; installedCssSha256: string; }`; written at `appearance.ts:120-123`.

### 1.2 Where `cssclasses` is decided (single site)

`render/common.ts:148-154` is the **only** place any `cssclasses` value is produced:

```ts
148 export function frontmatter(lines: string[]): string {
149   const noteType = lines.find((line) => /^type: scholar-(home|book|chapter|section|exam|exam-paper|answer-key|tutor)$/.test(line))?.slice(6);
150   return [
151     "---", ...lines, "cssclasses:", "  - alvar-learning", "  - scholar-note",
152     ...(noteType ? [`  - ${noteType}`] : []), "tags:", "  - scholar", "---",
153   ].join("\n");
154 }
```

The class is derived **from the emitted `type:` line**, not passed in. `slice(6)` strips `"type: "`.

|---|---|---|---|
| Home | `render/navigation.ts:25` `frontmatter(["type: scholar-home"])` | `scholar-home` | `alvar-learning`, `scholar-note`, `scholar-home` |
| Book hub | `render/navigation.ts:51-57` | `scholar-book` | `+ scholar-book` |
| Chapter | `render/navigation.ts:81-83` | `scholar-chapter` | `+ scholar-chapter` |
| Section | `render/section.ts:233-236` | `scholar-section` | `+ scholar-section` |
| Tutor session | `render/assessment.ts:304-307` | `scholar-tutor` | `+ scholar-tutor` |
| Exam receipt | `render/assessment.ts:243-247` | `scholar-exam` | `+ scholar-exam` |
| Answer key | `render/assessment.ts:195-198` | `scholar-answer-key` | `+ scholar-answer-key` |

#### 3.1a What is actually on disk (important divergence)

`note-storage.ts:94`:

1. `note-records.ts:147` `document = attachDetails(document, kind, metadata);` → inserts a collapsed `> [!info]- Scholar section details` with a fenced ```json blob **immediately after the start marker** (`note-records.ts:11`, `:29`).

> 
> #### Choices
> 
> 1. option one
> 2. option two
> 
> <!-- scholar:feedback:start -->
> > [!success] Correct
> > **Correct answer:** …
> >
> > **Feedback:** …
> <!-- scholar:feedback:end -->

> > { … }

## 4. Known-degraded / compromise points (quoted)

1. **Blockquote boundary fragility** — `render/common.ts:61-62`:
   > `// An unquoted blank line terminates the Markdown blockquote. Keep both`
   > `// boundaries so adjacent records cannot become one collapsed callout.`
   Implemented as a leading and trailing `""` in every `collapsedRecord()`.
2. **Tables assembled by hand everywhere.** No row builder exists: `navigation.ts:23,40,43,45` (four different column counts: 3/4/2/2), `section.ts:196`, `assessment.ts:176`. Escaping is the caller's responsibility via `tableText`/`tableWikiLink`; a missed call silently breaks the table. Comment at `render/common.ts:45` documents why the escaping exists.
3. **A documented past drift, guarded by one shared predicate** — `render/common.ts:108-111`:
   > `* the chapter checklist, exam/tutor scope lines, and the disk writer — must`
   > `* share this predicate so they cannot drift apart again.`
   (`isSectionMaterialized` `:112-114`).
4. **Duplicated scope→snapshot selection (verbatim duplicate lambda).**
   - `render/assessment.ts:47-53` (`tutorSourceFigures`):
     ```ts
     const selected = session.scope.sectionIds.length ? session.scope.sectionIds.includes(section.id)
       : session.scope.chapterIds.length ? session.scope.chapterIds.includes(chapter.id) : true;
     ```
   - `render/assessment.ts:278-282` (`renderTutorSession`) repeats the identical expression. Callers use different ones: `note-storage.ts:102` passes `tutorSourceFigures(...)` into `referencedFigureLines` while `renderTutorSession` itself computes the same set inline for `supplementalSourceFigureLines` — two code paths, one invariant.
   - `render/assessment.ts:108-109` (`examAnswerNoteText`) uses a **third** rule: `exam.scope.sectionIds.includes(section.id) ? section.snapshots || [] : []` — no `chapterIds` fallback, so a chapter-scoped exam contributes zero figures to its own paper.
5. **Figure sets can differ between artifacts of the same exam.** `render/assessment.ts:123` merges via `recordSourceFigures(exam.snapshots, snapshots)` while `:207` and `:210` use plain `exam.snapshots || []`. `recordSourceFigures` exists solely to paper over this — `render/assessment.ts:40` `/** Own figures come first; preserve historical section projection without duplicates. */`.
